answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where every agent presents a unique credential, as nectar for the registry, to prove its individual vitality. A verifier acts as a timber frame, anchoring agents to check their credentials against the network history. An honest node pays 1,000 units to register, but a sybil farm faces a prohibitive cost for 1,000 fakes. We mandate an echo of evidence-triggered nullifiers to slash identity duplicates, assuming no collusion.
